text.p: Panamanian soccer authorities have selected Orlando Munoz, trainer for the national team, as the new coach after sacking Cesar Maturana for a dismal record, local Telemetro Channel 13 reported Thursday.
Munoz, a Panamanian, was placed under contract until December 15, when World Cup elimination games are completed, Channel 13 reported. Salary information was not given.
Maturana, a Colombian, was sacked this week after the Panamanian team lost to Canada 1-3 August 30, lost to Cuba 1-3 September 22 and drew with El Salvador 1-1 October 6.
Munoz is also the coach of the Panamanian semi-professional team Club Eurokickers.
